description: Upgrade a problem to major or downgrade it to minor, as the Problems page does. The new tier replaces the judge's everywhere: the conversation's verdict, its category, run results, dashboards and release gates, so a run whose only major problem is downgraded passes. Change it only when the user says the judge's tier is wrong. Judging the conversation again starts from the judge's own tier.
